answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as a reef against Sybil attacks by tying identity validation to capital ownership. Since generating a meadow of fake agent identities provides no advantage without staked assets, the attacker must absorb the cost of capital allocation. At the dawn of network participation, this mechanism forces adversaries to forfeit economic value to control consensus weight, rendering the creation of infinite malicious personas prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
